subject: MAP weekly: POC signposts & go/no-go gating - MediSys trial
body:
From: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@medisys.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@medisys.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and acceptance clarity

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier. Our procurement contact looped in (procure@medisys.com) so we have the contracting path covered. Before we lock the trial dates, can you confirm the exact acceptance criteria your team will use for the POC? We want to align our clinical validation and infra teams so there are no surprises at the gate.

High level asks from our side:
- Target latency for inference under 95th pct load
- Failure/retry behavior for intermittent network outages
- Data handling / scoping for PHI during the trial

If you can share the MAP spreadsheet with milestones and owners, that will help us map internal reviewers.

Thanks,
Natalie
Senior Program Manager, MediSys Health

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@medisys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff and acceptance clarity

Hi Natalie — great questions. Attaching our working MAP (MAP-v1.xlsx) and a short checklist here to address the items you called out. We propose a weekly MAP checkpoint every Friday (30 min) for the next three weeks to track milestones and surface blockers; first checkpoint is 2027-04-04 11:00 PT.

POC acceptance — short version:
- Functional: model returns clinically relevant summaries for the 4 scenario prompts in the eval set with >= 85% pass rate against your annotator rubric.
- Performance: 95th percentile latency < 450ms for single-user scenarios; batch evaluation throughput to be validated during stress day.
- Reliability: end-to-end error rate < 0.5% over a 24h window during steady-state testing.
- Security: data-in-flight encrypted; we will run in VPC with access logging; PHI scope limited to deidentified payloads unless explicitly agreed.

Owners (Redwood):
- Integration & infra: Aditya Rao (aditya.rao@redwood.com) — provisioning, network/VPC, access tokens
- Eval & quality: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com) — eval harness, acceptance rubric, scoring
- Support & SLA ops: Sergio Alvarez (sergio.alvarez@redwood.com) — monitoring, fallback policies

Suggested MAP milestones (from MAP-v1):
1) Test dataset delivery (MediSys) — due 2027-04-05 — owner: Natalie (external)
2) Integration smoke tests — due 2027-04-07 — owner: Aditya
3) Eval run 1 & rubric scoring — due 2027-04-09 — owner: Marissa
4) Acceptance review & go/no-go decision — due 2027-04-12 — owners: Marissa + Natalie

Blockers we already see:
- Need access to a deidentified sample set with the timestamped fields (Natalie noted procurement gating for data transfer).
- SOC2 evidence request (security team asked for a short questionnaire). We attached SOC2-questions.pdf to expedite.

Action: Please confirm the 2027-04-05 dataset handoff date and whether procurement can approve the SFTP credentials exchange this week.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@medisys.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP weekly: integration checklist + infra items

Quick notes after reviewing the MAP and the onboarding checklist:
- For the SFTP transfer: we need an IP allowlist and an initial test user. If procurement can provide an endpoint and the deid sample dropbox, I will stand up the transfer job on our side.
- For latency gating: we should define the exact request shape and sample size for the 95th pct. I suggest 500 single-user synthetic requests across peak window to baseline.
- SOC2 questionnaire: I filled page 2 of SOC2-questions.pdf with initial answers (see attachment stub). We will still need a signed NDA for PHI work — procurement, can you confirm your NDA cadence?

Blockers (internal):
- Pending NDA signed by MediSys to move forward with PHI-like samples.
- Procurement timeline for SFTP/allowlist.

I'll set a short tech sync on Monday (2027-04-05) to lock the integration steps — 30m.

-Aditya
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@medisys.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly signpost notes & open action items (POC week 0)

Team — consolidating the checkpoint items from this week. Please treat this as the canonical weekly MAP snapshot.

Meeting: Weekly MAP checkpoint (POC week 0) — 2027-04-04 11:00 PT
Attendees: Tessa, Marissa, Aditya, Sergio, Natalie

Notes:
- Natalie confirmed sample delivery target: 2027-04-05 (procurement clearing this afternoon).
- Aditya will create one test SFTP user and provide allowlist IPs by EOD 2027-04-05.
- Marissa to run eval harness once samples land; initial run planned 2027-04-07.
- Sergio to provision monitoring dashboards and alert threshold for error rate (0.5%) by 2027-04-08.

Open action items (owner — due):
- Natalie / MediSys: finalize procurement signoff and share SFTP endpoint (procure@medisys.com) — due 2027-04-05
- Aditya Rao: create test user + firewall allowlist + transfer job stub — due 2027-04-05
- Marissa Cole: prepare eval harness config, upload rubric into MAP file, run initial scoring — due 2027-04-07
- Sergio Alvarez: dashboard + alert provisioning + runbook for intermittent errors — due 2027-04-08
- Tessa Morgan: coordinate weekly checkpoint invites and escalate procurement blockers to account exec if not cleared by 2027-04-06

Risks / blockers:
- Procurement hold on NDA and SFTP access is the critical path. If not cleared by 2027-04-06 we will not meet the 2027-04-12 acceptance review.
- Potential need for on-prem connector if they cannot share deidentified data via SFTP; that would add ~5 business days.

Next steps:
- Tech sync Monday 2027-04-05 09:30 PT (Aditya to lead).
- Share MAP-v1.xlsx link and update owners after initial transfers.

Attachments referenced: MAP-v1.xlsx, SOC2-questions.pdf

Thanks — short and action-focused. Reply with any corrections to owners/dates.

-Marissa Cole
Senior Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
